title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage Reversals: the Liability Limit
content:
The liability limit for a reversed lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan follows the claimed transaction and the loss report. The loss counts as reported on the date of the single replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among the account's lost and stolen replacement orders of the last 12 months, and no transfer is charged in full.

| Condition | Limit |
|---|---|
| The claimed transaction is a purchase and the plan applies Visa Zero Liability (the Advantage plan does) | zero |
| Otherwise, that report came more than 2 business days after the loss date | 500.00 |
| Otherwise | 50.00 |

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

**Hypothetical pair.** A loss learned on a Monday and reported by a stolen-card replacement on the Wednesday is on time: Tuesday and Wednesday are 2 business days, and the limit is 50.00. Reported on the Thursday, it is late, and the limit is 500.00.
